verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs cover the parts of a board pack: board-ready variance analysis and versioned forecasts, AI-written variance commentary (Scan), reporting automation, and an agent that updates or builds reports from live data. However, no evidence shows it producing a finished board pack or slide deck in one step. Missing for 10: a documented board-pack or slide/deck output combining metrics, commentary and forecast; export to presentation formats; independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate a board pack (metrics, variance commentary, forecast) from the live model instead of assembling slides by hand

citations.quote: Versioned forecasts, scenario modeling, and board-ready variance analysis.
